description: Defines data structures and classes for managing UE (User Equipment) context in a 3GPP-related system, including context list management, timers, and logging.

classes.name: nrppa_ue_context
classes.description: Represents the context of a UE, including identifiers, timers, and measurement data.

classes.name: nrppa_ue_context_list
classes.description: Manages a collection of UE contexts, allowing addition, removal, and lookup.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a new UE context to the list.

methods.name: update_ue_index
methods.description: Updates the UE index and associated notifier.

methods.name: remove_ue_context
methods.description: Removes a UE context based on UE index.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of UE contexts managed.

methods.name: allocate_ran_ue_meas_id
methods.description: Allocates the next available RAN UE measurement ID.
